snippet.title: Deductopia trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Duck Detective, Little Problems, and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.

Deductopia by @nightwellgames is coming soon!

Deductopia in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/deductopia/
Deductopia on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4429720/Deductopia/
Deductopia on Itch: https://gwenckatz.itch.io/deductopia

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
